  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Political organizing: They built support among peasants, workers, and students, establishing a network of underground cells and alliances with other groups opposed to the Somoza regime.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Propaganda: They produced newspapers, radio broadcasts, and other media to spread their message.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] International support: They sought support from countries like Cuba and the Soviet Union and appealed to international organizations such as the United Nations and the Organization of American States.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular mobilization: They organized marches, demonstrations, strikes, and boycotts to disrupt the economy and pressure the government.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Military training: They trained their fighters in military tactics and supplied them with weapons and ammunition.
